dialogues.speaker: Amazolli
dialogues.text: Hello there, and welcome to Idukan's Trove.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to browse your wares...

dialogues.speaker: Amazolli
dialogues.text: Just as you only know what's delicious after you've eaten much, you only know your books after you've read broadly!

dialogues.speaker: Amazolli
dialogues.text: I read it in a book of legends, but the details of the content escape me nowadays... Still, I recall that its own owner was a figure of much wisdom.

dialogues.speaker: Amazolli
dialogues.text: Wisdom comes in many forms. Printed on paper, woven upon cloth, and even spread by word of mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Amazolli
dialogues.text: And that's why I named my store after them.

dialogues.speaker: Amazolli
dialogues.text: See you. May wisdom keep you from the wrong paths.

dialogues.speaker: Amazolli
dialogues.text: The great Iktomisaur elder's full name means "He of the Sharp Mist-Shaded Claws," while mine, "Amazolli," means "Ancient Collection of Texts."

dialogues.speaker: Amazolli
dialogues.text: So, here I am, running a bookstore.

dialogues.speaker: Amazolli
dialogues.text: Just as shamans can gain a glimpse into fate in their dreams, all things have a trail you can follow.
